metadata.title: Clicked like I’m trying to open a snack bag and somehow popped 1 enemy? Valorant’s drunk again
metadata.description:
Me: wildly smashing buttons like it’s a secret dance
Enemy: probably wondering how their life led here
Valorant logic: ‘Here’s a surprise kill, take it!’

Tap if your panic aim ever gifts you the impossible!
